scope: Attempt hover on every disabled control in the native QtQuick5/6 test gallery, retaining the existing hover-delay, stable-position, screen-bounds, owner-overlap and leave-dismiss checks.

runtime.profiles: per-run disposable HOME, KDE colors config and private D-Bus/network namespace

method.probe: Private copy of the established R4 native QtQuick matrix probe; removed only its early skip for controls with enabled=false. The regular pointer/tooltip criteria were unchanged.
method.runner: run_t07_qtquick_matrix_r4.py with --quick and the private probe
method.tested_targets: All materialized native gallery controls on three pages, including seven disabled controls per Qt version.

limits: The proof covers the project's QtQuick native gallery, not unrelated applications or historical SR10.4 pixels.
QtQuick5 disabled controls expose tooltip text semantically but do not receive hover in this gallery; a future solution must not enable or activate them merely to show a hint.

The initial diagnostic run used an incorrect output-path mode and the runner rejected its final aggregation after the matrices had been saved. It is excluded; R127 uses the clean second run where both version runners exited successfully.

discarded_followup_prototypes.approach: Observe pointer motion with a HoverHandler on the enabled gallery parent and drive the disabled controls' attached ToolTip after a 750 ms timer.
discarded_followup_prototypes.result: Did not expose hints in QtQuick5; the observer did not identify the disabled control under the pointer. The attempt also revealed one pre-existing hover-matrix cold-check contamination when a preceding popup remained visible.

discarded_followup_prototypes.approach: Place transparent MouseArea siblings over disabled controls, with acceptedButtons=Qt.NoButton and an attached delayed ToolTip.
discarded_followup_prototypes.result: The MouseAreas did not report hover in the isolated QtQuick5 gallery; the matrix failed those seven targets. No code was retained.

conclusion: QtQuick5 and QtQuick6 differ for disabled-control hover in the tested runtime. The QtQuick5 gap remains open; all enabled controls tested in both versions passed the existing hover criteria. No production source was changed.
next: Continue T07 at another uncovered authorized scope. Return to QtQuick5 disabled-control hints only with a new event-delivery hypothesis; the parent HoverHandler and MouseArea overlay trials are recorded and should not be repeated.
